# LANspector

> Cross-platform LAN & Windows fileshare auditor for SOX permission-diff reporting and Plotly storage sunburst analytics.

- Repository: https://github.com/aberndsen/lanspector
- Docs: https://aberndsen.github.io/lanspector/
- Usage Guide: https://aberndsen.github.io/lanspector/usage.html
- SOX Auditing Guide: https://aberndsen.github.io/lanspector/auditing_guide.html
- Sunburst & Dashboard Guide: https://aberndsen.github.io/lanspector/sunburst_dashboard_guide.html
- API Reference: https://aberndsen.github.io/lanspector/api/index.html
